high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a contemporary design aesthetic. The room features a wooden sofa set with light gray cushions and brown throw pillows. The sofas are arranged around a central wooden coffee table that holds decorative items such as a vase with dried flowers and small bowls. To the right of the coffee table is a side table with a tissue box on top. The floor is covered by a geometric-patterned rug in shades of blue, gray, and white, which adds a pop of color to the otherwise neutral-toned room.
